items.title: Costco Ramps Up Same-Day Delivery, Expanding Uber, DoorDash Partnerships
items.summary: Costco is expanding its fast delivery network as it works to grow sales in new ways.  Earlier this week Uber said it would expand its partnership with Costco to deliver products in 47 U.S. states, up from 17 states.  On Thursday DoorDash said it would also start delivering Costco products in the U.S. from all U.S. locations.

items.title: DoorDash Expands Costco Partnership to Offer Same-Day Delivery Across the US
items.summary: DoorDash (NASDAQ:DASH) and Costco Wholesale Corporation (NASDAQ:COST) have expanded their partnership to include all Costco warehouse locations in the United States, allowing members to order products for same-day delivery through the DoorDash app. The nationwide rollout gives Costco members access to more than 4,000 products from their local warehouse, including groceries, household essentials, electronics, seasonal merchandise and Kirkland Signature items.
